params.body:
The Tachograaf section on /diensten was mostly provisional text. Schoutteet's own flyer for the service now fills it: the company specialises in placing and calibrating tachographs in motorhomes over 7.5 tonnes, with professional finishing and personal service.

## What changes

- Lead: approved installer, placing and calibrating tachographs in trucks and in motorhomes over 7.5 t (translated in en/fr/de/es, like the other leads).
- Paragraphs: the approved-installer and COP paragraph from the old site stays; two provisional paragraphs (device types, roller test, driver card readout) give way to the flyer's points, marked `schoutteet`.
- FAQ: a new confirmed question about motorhomes. The two remaining questions stay marked as to be confirmed.
- Facts: the unsourced "ISO 9001" and "Controle terwijl u wacht" are gone; "Mobilhomes van meer dan 7,5 ton" and "Plaatsing, ijking en afwerking" come in.
- Steps stay provisional, adjusted to mention motorhomes.
- The `Services` docblock names the `schoutteet` source the Studio already uses.

## Live text is in Sanity

The site reads services from Sanity once there are any, so this PR only changes the built-in fallback and the seed. The live page changes when the `service-tachograaf` document in production is replaced, either in the Studio or by importing the exported document on its own (`sanity dataset import <file> production --replace`, which touches only that `_id`), then `php artisan sanity:sync`.

## Tests

`php artisan test`: 55 passed. Pint clean on the changed file.

Closes #27
